analysis.evidence: Abram is the subject. בָּאָרֶץ identifies the land he passed through, and עַד מְקוֹם שְׁכֶם marks how far he went, as far as Shechem.
analysis.morphology: Prefixed conjunction וַ with a Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, agreeing with אַבְרָם.
